rows: Disability Employment Services - Outcome Rates by Disability Type
Hello and welcome to the Disability Employment Services (DES) Outcome Rates by Disability Type information.
It is highly recommended that you read the below information, before looking at the available Providers in your area.
How do I use the 'Outcome Rates by Disability' sheet?
Disability Employment Services - Outcome Rates by Disability Type
1. One option must be selected in all slicers/filters for the correct information to display in the 'Provider List Table'
2. Additional information about how to best make use of this data is available on the 'Information' sheet
3. To clear a selection from a slicer, use the 'Clear Filter' button for each applicable slicer.
Disability Employment Services - Outcome Rates by Disability Type LMR
1. One option must be selected in all slicers/filters for the correct information to display in the 'Provider List Table'
2. Additional information about how to best make use of this data is available on the 'Information' sheet
3. To clear a selection from a slicer, use the 'Clear Filter' button for each applicable slicer.
Search for your Employment Services Area by Postcode
Please enter your postcode into the yellow cell.
1. If you don't know your postcode, you can find it on the Australia post website.
2. Some postcodes might be included in multiple Employment Services areas, in this case you can refer to Employment Services Area maps.
To access the ESA maps, on the National Map website, select Explore map data > Data.gov.au > Department of Social Services > ESAs 2013+ > Add to the map
You can either use the filter function or find (Ctrl + F)
to search for your disability or medical condition.
